name: NeRF-guided MDE Adaptation
definition: A process to adapt the pre-trained MDE network to the specific scene's absolute geometry using NeRF as a prior, resolving ambiguities like convexity/concavity and orientation.
summary: NeRF-guided MDE Adaptation refines monocular depth networks by using NeRF geometry to resolve ambiguities, distinguishing itself by explicitly adapting MDE weights to specific scenes rather than using static supervision.
